feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 May 2026 5:10am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 22 May 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure area in the mid-Atlantic and a high pressure area over continental Europe, with a warm and moist southerly air stream in the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 3 or 4, quickly veering south or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 3 or less in the far southeast of the area, falling 3 or 4 in all waters overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight early in the night. Remaining smooth in the far southeast of the area throughout the period.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches in the morning and afternoon, especially in the west of the area.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south of the area later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south of the area later. Remaining smooth in the far southeast of the area throughout the period.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches, but many areas fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.
